name: Marvell Co-packaged Optics: Powering the Next Wave of AI Data Center Innovation
notes: First-party technical blog by Chris McCormick (Product Management Director, Cloud Platform Group at Marvell) detailing Marvell's 6.4T CPO light engine tiles, 102.4 Tbps CPO switch reference design with 16 light engine tiles and 1,152 fibers, and 1U 4-XPU scale-up compute tray with 1,024 data fibers.
